events.title: Mongols sack Vladimir in north-eastern Rus
events.description: Batu Khan's army stormed and burned Vladimir, the capital of the leading Russian principality. The Mongol conquest brought the Russian lands under the Golden Horde for some two centuries.
events.html: Batu Khan's army stormed and burned Vladimir, the capital of the leading Russian principality. The Mongol conquest brought the Russian lands under the Golden Horde for some two centuries.

events.title: The Byzantine civil war ends in a power-sharing agreement
events.description: The civil war fought over the guardianship of the young John V Palaiologos, between the regency of Anna of Savoy and John VI Kantakouzenos, ended in a power-sharing agreement. Kantakouzenos then reigned as emperor until 1354.
events.html: The civil war fought over the guardianship of the young John V Palaiologos, between the regency of Anna of Savoy and John VI Kantakouzenos, ended in a power-sharing agreement. Kantakouzenos then reigned as emperor until 1354.

events.title: Mary, Queen of Scots is executed at Fotheringhay
events.description: After nineteen years in English captivity, Mary was beheaded for plotting against Elizabeth I. Her execution removed the Catholic claimant to the English throne and helped provoke the Spanish Armada.
events.html: After nineteen years in English captivity, Mary was beheaded for plotting against Elizabeth I. Her execution removed the Catholic claimant to the English throne and helped provoke the Spanish Armada.

events.title: Royal charter founds the College of William and Mary
events.description: William III and Mary II granted a charter for a college in Virginia, later sited at Williamsburg. It is the second-oldest college in the United States; Thomas Jefferson studied there.
events.html: William III and Mary II granted a charter for a college in Virginia, later sited at Williamsburg. It is the second-oldest college in the United States; Thomas Jefferson studied there.

events.title: Delaware rejects the Thirteenth Amendment
events.description: Delaware's legislature voted against the amendment abolishing slavery, although the state had remained in the Union. It ratified the amendment only symbolically, in 1901.
events.html: Delaware's legislature voted against the amendment abolishing slavery, although the state had remained in the Union. It ratified the amendment only symbolically, in 1901.

events.title: Japan attacks the Russian fleet at Port Arthur
events.description: Japanese torpedo boats struck the Russian Pacific squadron at night, opening the Russo-Japanese War. Japan's victory in 1905 was the first by an Asian power over a European one in modern times.
events.html: Japanese torpedo boats struck the Russian Pacific squadron at night, opening the Russo-Japanese War. Japan's victory in 1905 was the first by an Asian power over a European one in modern times.

events.title: 'The Birth of a Nation' premieres in Los Angeles
events.description: D. W. Griffith's Civil War epic pioneered techniques of film storytelling but glorified the Ku Klux Klan. It drew protests from the NAACP and helped inspire the Klan's revival that year.
events.html: D. W. Griffith's Civil War epic pioneered techniques of film storytelling but glorified the Ku Klux Klan. It drew protests from the NAACP and helped inspire the Klan's revival that year.

events.title: Skylab 4 crew return after 84 days in space
events.description: Gerald Carr, Edward Gibson and William Pogue splashed down after the longest crewed mission yet. Their experience of long-duration flight informed later space stations.
events.html: Gerald Carr, Edward Gibson and William Pogue splashed down after the longest crewed mission yet. Their experience of long-duration flight informed later space stations.
